plan.notes: Source: UM Catalog, Spring 2025-26 edition, B.A. in Psychology degree requirements page. Catalog publishes requirements only; no official semester-by-semester sequence exists for this program, so this plan is requirements_only. Minimum total credit hours: 120. General education recorded per published table (writing I/II 3+3, literature survey 6, modern/ancient language 200+ 6, history 6, humanities 3, social science 6, fine arts 3, math 100+ 3); science requirement recorded at minimum credits per convention (full-year sequence in one subject area 6, second subject area 3, two associated science labs 2). Major = 30 hrs: Psy 201/202/205 (9), three of six core courses (9), one capstone (3), nine hours psychology electives (9). Per convention, choice slots recorded at minimum credit. Remaining 40 hrs recorded as general electives so the plan sums to the published 120 total; the BA is designed to integrate a minor field of study. Grade of C or better required in all major coursework (including prerequisites); no more than 6 combined hrs from Psy 401, 402, 403, 405, 406, 408, 420, 421, 506 may count toward the major; at least 12 major hrs in residence with C or better. A Behavior Analysis emphasis (BCaBA-aligned) is also offered and adds emphasis-specific coursework, but this plan models the base B.A. major only.
